selection.stage1_rule: Use complete and identical official Tuning coverage to diagnose the control, robust statistics, direct timestamp pairwise alignment, and refreshed coarser geometry axes.
selection.stage2_rule: This diagnostic does not authorize Eval or parameter lock; any follow-up mechanism must be frozen in a new Tuning-only protocol.
selection.dataset_specific_rule: All comparisons are dataset-specific; track fallback is forbidden.

diagnostic_axes.d1_stats: retain robust patch level and scale alongside normalized shape
diagnostic_axes.d2_pairwise: direct timestamp and shared-interval cosine consistency
diagnostic_axes.d3_geometry: coarser intermediate regions rebuilt once during training

visual_evidence: raw normal and anomalous time-series intervals
selected observed prototypes with support, radius, and source time
